overview: Fort Erie had 32,901 residents in 2021, up 7.1 per cent from 2016, living in 14,081 occupied homes spread across 166 square kilometres. That population is split among several distinct communities, so a business in Ridgeway and one in Crystal Beach often serve different customers.

The town sits at the Peace Bridge, draws visitors to its race track and beaches, and is adding manufacturing jobs. Local firms compete for residents, cross-border traffic and seasonal visitors at once, which rewards clear local positioning.

byService.lead-generation: With 14,081 households spread across several separate communities, lead generation in Fort Erie works best when campaigns target Ridgeway, Stevensville or Crystal Beach individually rather than the whole town.

byService.branding: Branding in Fort Erie should feel rooted in a specific community, because residents identify strongly with Crystal Beach, Ridgeway or Bridgeburg and reward businesses that clearly belong there.
